signal: Loop raised a $95M Series C in April 2026 led by Valor and is investing heavily in AI and revenue engineering talent to scale its platform

email.body1:
Yang, saw Loop closed its $95M Series C and is doubling down on AI and revenue engineering.

When the platform scales that fast, the revenue engine usually has more in-market accounts to cover than the team can touch, and signal-to-meeting latency is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Loop off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Yang, quick follow-up for Loop.

Post-raise, the revenue side usually needs to turn signals into booked meetings faster than headcount allows. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Loop needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Yang, last bit of proof for Loop.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Loop's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Yang, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the post-raise build is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a revenue engineering motion? I will tailor it to Loop either way.
